response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_pct, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table, so zero-telescope observatories are excluded. The average share is the unweighted mean across those observatories, and 'above average' means strictly greater than that mean.

alternatives.interpretation: Every observatory in the observatories table counts, including those with zero telescopes (count 0, share 0). The average share is then taken across all observatories.
alternatives.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_pct, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM above;
